item.title: Core Keeper Crop Profit Calculator — Best Crops by Profit Per Hour
item.description: Which crop makes the most money per hour in Core Keeper? This crop profit calculator ranks every verified crop by profit per harvest cycle — sell value and fixed 10-minute growth time, filterable by ground type so you can plan farms for Dirt, Beach and Crystal biomes. Every crop takes a fixed 10 minutes from watered seed to harvest (2 sprout + 4 grow + 4 mature). Profit below assumes manual harvest and self-grown seeds — adjust seed cost to your own runs.

item.title: Core Keeper Farming & Crops FAQ — Growth, Golden Crops, Profit
Core Keeper Greenhouse Guide — Crop Layout, Harvest Chance and Golden Crop Profit
item.description: A greenhouse is where Core Keeper shifts from “scavenge food” to “manufacture buffs.” This advanced guide covers the growth cycle, picking crops by ground type, stacking harvest chance for throughput, and laying out plots so watering never becomes a chore. The 10-minute growth cycle Once you water a seed, the timer runs on its own — you can leave and come back: Stage Time Watered seed → sprout 2 minutes Sprout → pre-harvest 4 minutes Pre-harvest → harvestable 4 minutes Every manual harvest grants gardening experience.

item.title: Mob Farming
item.description: Mob Farming is a Farming mod for Core Keeper available on mod.io. Makes Materializer-spawned enemies drop loot and boosts Galaxite Turret damage from 200 to 1000 base — end-game resource farming. What it does Materializer-spawned enemies now drop loot Galaxite Turret damage boosted from 200 to 1000 base The end-game way to farm materials without leaving your base How to install In the main menu, open Mods → Browse (mod.io) and search for the mod, then Subscribe.
